summary: Persistent internal representations (amendment item 3, KF-E04). Before PS every core call passed state=None: no recurrent / persistent latent state (spec 1.3), b depended on the re-encoded window only. PS: nn/persist.py PersistentStateChain carries the core slots across decisions (positions = committed decisions; the state of a position is recomputed from the stored anchor K=2 decisions back with the current weights, so decision-time and replayed beliefs are one function and gradients cross K decision boundaries); CamLiveModel.core_forward resolves state=None through the attached chain; learned per-slot retention rho (0 = the pre-PS computation, set for legacy checkpoints). Agent threading PS-1 applied by ST in dde7d2d. Default OFF since 551ff3b (persistent_state.enabled: false): no measurable benefit on the evaluated experience; initial()/reset() API, weights-only export starts at the initial chain state.

AM3-audit.claim: the pre-PS design does not satisfy spec 1.3 'recurrent or persistent latent state' nor CAM_LIVE_ARCHITECTURE section 2 (slots carried between calls); spec 2.1 m_t half met (fast posterior not an input of F_theta)

AM3-implementation.evidence: finite differences through K transitions; decision-time = replay to 1e-6; rho=0 / fresh states bit-identical to the pre-PS core (check_bitident.json)

AM3-integration.evidence: agent-level tests pass in the repository; runtime runs: every learner re-encoding resolved to a stored position (rows_fresh 0); test_agent_recovery passes with the chain on

AM3-causal.evidence: within-decision counterfactual: debug TV 0.0094 per decision, relative change of b 0.265 (149 decisions); full size (SW:rle, substantive protocol): at the one decision with carried state TV 0.0023, the policy's argmax changed, b changed 14.9 %

AM3-improvement.state: negative on real experience (honest result), positive on the synthetic memory task
AM3-improvement.evidence: synthetic memory: out-of-window accuracy 0.29 -> 0.80 (K=2, 3 seeds; rho started closed: opened to 0.33-0.44, accuracy 0.60); fixed-stream replay, debug: prequential NLL on-off -0.005 (SE 0.003, 28 pairs), long objectives -0.008 (SE 0.006, 6), held-out codec block -0.027 (SE 0.009, on better in 21/28, sign p 0.012), retention no difference; full size (Qwen3-4B + 50m, three real streams incl. the live run, 3 model seeds): -0.006 (SE 0.006, 9 pairs, on better in 5); on-line on/off outcomes dominated by trajectory divergence (16 LabWorld lifetimes: progress +0.094 SD 0.144)

AM3-compatibility.state: verified on the live run's checkpoint
AM3-compatibility.evidence: ckpt_00000039 of the live planning run restored by the PS agent on the real configuration: no missing / unexpected weights, no signature difference, legacy path closes rho, b and b_next of 24 stored decisions bit-identical with and without the chain; opening rho at once would move them 7.2 %
